lines: Full. First time in eleven years and it is not the good kind of full.
Half of them are aeronauts who cannot fly and the other half are people they cannot take.
Sit down anyway. Nobody in Skyreach has ever been turned out of the Crosswind.
The Crosswind. We are the place you end up when you are on the wrong side at the wrong hour.
Last car off the Cradle is eleven, and about a third of this room missed it.
Nobody says anything about it. We have all missed it.
Six crates of Aurelian glass and a hold booked for Friday, and there is no Friday.
Glass does not go by road. Glass has never gone by road. That is the whole point of glass.
So I sit here, and I own six crates of the finest thing in Caelora, four hundred feet up.
Fenn gave you the Crest. She gave me one in 1859 and I have it upstairs in a drawer.
I was better than you at your age and I have had sixty years to be honest about that.
I was not. Sit down. I will tell you what I actually was.
Forty-one years on the masts and I have got all my fingers, which nobody believes.
You keep them by being frightened at the right times and only the right times.
The wind out there this month is the wrong times. I have not been up since the spring.
